text:
maria: quick sync — i'm about to open the rollout gate for NA->EU failover tests. goal: validate routing fallback + session-stickiness when eu capacity is constrained. planning a small canary (2%) for next 2h window.

ajay: sounds good. is the canary by user-id or cookie?

maria: by user_id (auth_id) so it maps to consistent affinity across requests. cookie fallback if unauthenticated.

sophia: FYI we updated the sticky ttl to 45s in the last PR (see #4382). is that still ok for the eu region latency profile?

ajay: 45s okay for most flows, but docs-search flow might need longer (100s). can we make it configurable per route?

maria: yes, plan is per-route override. default 45s, override /search -> 120s.

jamal: are we enforcing guardrails to prevent fallback to tiny-quant model during business hours? last outage showed quality regressions when that happened.

maria: good call. guardrail policy = block fallback to <4GB-quant models between 08:00-20:00 in EU/NA. outside window allow burst fallback.

ops-oncall: please add me as a watcher. also include metrics to alert on: user-reported quality drop >3% and avg tokens per response delta >20% in 10m.

maria: added you. alert rule draft: `alert: FailoverQualityRegression`

ajay: can someone paste the ff toggle command we will run?

maria: running this from ops CLI, exact: ```
ops-cli feature-flag enable rollout_gates.failover-eu-na --scope region=eu --canary 2 --overrides '{"routes":{"/search":{"sticky_ttl":120}},"guardrails":{"no_tiny_models":"08:00-20:00"}}'
```

sophia: lgtm. please ensure the PR that changes the sticky default is merged before toggle. also add a migration note for sessioncookie behavior.

maria: PR #4399 merged 10 min ago. migration note in the description.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle: rollout_gates.failover-eu-na will be enabled at 2026-03-17T17:00:00Z (canary=2%).

jamal: quick code-review ping on the guardrail evaluation (PR #4405). small logic nit in policy matcher.

ajay: i'll take it now.

ajay: reviewed and approved, left one comment about timezone parsing.

maria: thumbs up. i'll kickoff the toggle at :00. running smoke checks after enabling: 1) route correctness 2) sticky persistence 3) model variant sanity 4) latency p50/p95 < target.

ops-oncall: keep the incident channel open for 30m post-toggle: #incidents/failover-watch. i'll monitor anomalies.

sophia: small request — can we add a short-circuit flag so we can immediately roll back to current routing without draining sessions? just in case.

maria: added emergency rollback flag `failover-eu-na.force-off` — ops CLI can flip it to off. will test rollback flow in staging now.

jamal: staging rollback tested, sessions reattached correctly within 2s for authenticated users, cookie flows need ~8s. documented in runbook.

maria: perfect. i'll post the runbook link after toggle. please ack if you're watching.

ajay: watching.

sophia: watching.

ops-oncall: watching, will escalate if alerts fire.

deploy-bot: rollout_gates.failover-eu-na enabled by maria at 2026-03-17T17:00:05Z (canary=2%).

maria: smoke check 1/4 route correctness: OK. 2/4 sticky persistence: OK for auth, cookie fallback ~7s. 3/4 model variant sanity: OK (no tiny-quant used). 4/4 latency p95 within SLO.

ops-oncall: alert fired (quality-regression) at 17:20, investigating.

jamal: checking logs — small uptick in search-term truncation for the cookie-anchored sessions routed to fallback instance. looks like cookie expiry edge-case.

sophia: can we increase cookie TTL to 30s for the canary audience to stabilize?

maria: bumping cookie ttl to 30s for canary now. ```ops-cli feature-flag update rollout_gates.failover-eu-na --overrides '{"cookie_ttl":30}'```

deploy-bot: feature-flag updated by maria at 2026-03-17T17:24:10Z.

ops-oncall: quality alert cleared at 17:31. monitoring steady.

maria: thanks all. plan: keep canary at 2% for additional 3h, then increment to 10% if no regressions and no major alerts. i'll update the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/failover-eu-na-checklist

ajay: please file a follow-up to handle cookie->auth mapping edge-case (postmortem-ish).

maria: filed ticket RD-1217. closing sync thread. :white_check_mark:
